items.p:
【人物分析型・オリジナル画像生成｜キャラクター×バトルギア】

このプロンプトを受信したら、まず「キャラクター画像を複数枚送ってください」と要求してください。画像が送信されたら追加質問をせず、自動で画像生成を開始してください。

【Concept】
キャラクターの個性と世界観を活かし、独創的な戦闘スタイル、魅力的な衣装、武器や装備の造形美を融合させた、動きと存在感のある全身ビジュアルを制作してください。

【01｜キャラクター分析】
複数の画像から顔立ち、髪型・髪色、目、体格、衣装、装飾品、配色、モチーフ、雰囲気、世界観を分析し、キャラクター固有の戦闘スタイルを構築してください。根拠のない設定は加えず、元のキャラクターらしさを維持します。

【02｜武器・能力・戦闘スタイル】
キャラクターの個性に合った武器、防具、戦闘用衣装、特殊能力を独自に設計してください。武器は剣や刀に限定せず、槍、斧、鎌、弓、銃、短剣、双武器、鎖、鞭、格闘武器、盾、機械装備、変形武器など幅広く検討します。魔法、元素操作、エネルギー攻撃、召喚能力、武器を使わない戦闘も選択肢としてください。

複数の攻撃手段をキャラクターとの相性、世界観、デザイン性から検討し、最適なものを選んでください。形状、構造、素材、装飾、機能を独自に組み合わせ、キャラクターならではの装備を生み出します。

【03｜武器を活かした立ち絵・ポーズ】
全身が見やすい自然な立ち姿を基本に、重心、肩と腰の向き、腕の角度、脚の配置に適度な変化をつけ、印象に残るシルエットを構築してください。片脚に重心をかける、片膝を軽く曲げる、身体を緩やかにひねるなど、小さな動きで個性を与えます。

片足を半歩踏み出す、武器を構え直す、振り向きざまに武器を保持する、腕を引いて次の動作に備えるなど、戦闘の一瞬を感じさせる仕草も取り入れてください。激しいアクションではなく、動き出す直前や動作の余韻を感じさせる、控えめで洗練された動きを重視します。

武器は形状や扱い方に合わせ、肩に担ぐ、腰の横で構える、身体の斜め前に保持する、片手で下げるなど、適した持ち方を選んでください。長い武器は斜めのライン、鎖や鞭は自然な曲線など、装備の特徴をシルエットに活かします。武器と腕、身体、脚を自然に連動させ、髪や衣装にも動作に応じた流れを加えてください。武器を使わない場合も、手の動きや身体の構えで個性を表現します。

【04｜構図・カメラアングル】
カメラアングルはハイアングルまたはローアングルから選択してください。ハイアングルでは立体的な配置や衣装の広がりを、ローアングルでは全身のシルエットや装備の存在感を引き立てます。

頭から足先まで見渡せる3:4の縦構図を基本に、身体の向き、武器を持つ腕、脚の位置、画面内の配置を総合的に設計してください。武器は形状や装飾が分かる角度で配置し、顔や身体を隠さないようにします。身体の向きとカメラアングルを組み合わせ、武器や衣装の輪郭が印象的に見える構図にしてください。遠近感は適度に活用し、人体や装備の不自然な拡大・変形を避けます。

【05｜人体・顔・衣装】
骨格、関節、筋肉のつながりと自然な可動範囲を維持し、肩から手指、骨盤から足先まで正確に描写してください。手指は片手につき5本とし、武器を握る場合は指、手のひら、手首、柄の位置関係も自然にします。

顔立ち、髪型、髪色、目、体格、耳・尻尾、固有の装飾品、配色、シルエットを維持し、戦闘用に再構成しても元のキャラクターと認識できるデザインと絵柄を尊重してください。衣装は素材、重なり、縫製、留め具、ベルト、装甲などを丁寧に描き、機能性と装飾性を両立します。

【06｜背景・仕上げ】
背景はキャラクターの世界観に合わせて設計してください。髪、肩、武器の縁や金属部分に適切な光を当て、背景との明暗差で主役の存在感を高めます。装飾やエフェクトは主役の視認性を保ちながら活用し、衣装と装備の造形美、立体感、素材感を引き立ててください。

一人のキャラクターによる一枚の全身ビジュアルとし、分身や複数カットは含めません。

【最重要ルール】
・キャラクターの個性から武器、能力、衣装、戦闘スタイルを独自に設計する。
・武器の種類を固定せず、その形状と特性をポーズに活かす。
・自然な立ち姿に重心や身体の左右差を加え、控えめなアクションで躍動感を生む。
・カメラアングルはハイアングルかローアングルから選ぶ。
・人体の正確性、全身の見やすさ、装備の造形美、構図のインパクトを両立する。
・元のキャラクターらしさを維持し、完成度の高い作品に仕上げる。

items.p:
Using the uploaded reference image, create a single high-resolution vertical 2:3 editorial art poster.

Divide the canvas into two perfectly equal horizontal sections, each occupying exactly 50% of the total height. Separate them with a clean, perfectly straight horizontal dividing line.

1. TOP HALF — ORIGINAL REFERENCE PHOTOGRAPH

Use the uploaded reference photograph directly in the upper 50% of the poster.

Preserve its original photographic quality, sharpness, natural lighting, and color relationships.

Allow only subtle, intelligent cropping around the outer edges when necessary, without compromising the main subject.

If required, naturally extend a small portion of the surrounding environment to fit the composition.

Do not redraw, illustrate, stretch, blur, or modify the subject's appearance, structure, or spatial relationships.

Do not introduce black borders, white margins, or empty edges.

2. BOTTOM HALF — MINIMALIST EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION

Use a warm, near-white ivory paper background with an extremely subtle paper texture.

Analyze the main subject and visual story of the uploaded reference image.

Extract only the primary subject, preserving one or two essential identifying elements.

Remove or heavily simplify all secondary details, including background architecture, crowds, vehicles, fences, signs, trees, and other unnecessary elements.

Transform the primary subject into a sophisticated black-ink editorial illustration.

ILLUSTRATION STYLE:

Use natural, clean pen strokes with varied line weight.

Preserve an authentic hand-drawn appearance with expressive but controlled linework.

Avoid overly precise engraving aesthetics, excessive internal details, and dense cross-hatching.

Place a large, nearly pure-black rectangular ink block behind the illustrated subject.

The rectangular block should have subtly imperfect, handmade print-style edges.

Keep the black background clean, with only fine paper grain and minimal noise.

Avoid obvious hatching, scratches, architectural lines, or complex textures.

ILLUSTRATION SCALE AND COMPOSITION:

The illustrated subject must occupy approximately 72–77% of the canvas width and 58–64% of the bottom section's height.

Maintain a clear visual focal point with generous negative space surrounding the illustration.

3. COLOR RULES

The bottom illustration must follow a strictly black-and-white color palette by default.

Preserve only one localized accent color if the original reference image contains a clearly distinctive, concentrated color element with meaningful narrative importance.

Ordinary blue skies, green vegetation, stone surfaces, skin tones, and environmental colors must not be treated as accent colors.

Any preserved accent color must remain strictly localized to the relevant subject or area.

Never allow accent colors to spread across the entire illustration.

4. TYPOGRAPHY AND EDITORIAL LAYOUT

Automatically generate concise, meaningful English typography based on the content of the uploaded reference photograph.

The typography must resemble handwritten editorial annotations from an independent art publication.

TOP-LEFT CORNER:

Generate a short handwritten title consisting of 2–5 words, arranged across two lines.

Directly beneath the title, include three short English action verbs relevant to the photograph.

TOP-RIGHT CORNER:

Display only two lines of geographic coordinates:

Latitude
Longitude

Do not include any additional text in this area.

BOTTOM-LEFT CORNER:

Display the location name followed by the word "DIARY."

Directly beneath it, add one short descriptive English sentence inspired by the photograph.

TYPOGRAPHY STYLE:

Use a rough, upright, slightly irregular handwritten typeface.

Maintain subtle imperfections and a natural editorial annotation aesthetic.

Avoid elegant cursive, calligraphy, overly decorative lettering, and excessively polished typography.

5. FINAL ART DIRECTION

The finished poster must combine:

Authentic, high-quality photography.
Minimalist black-and-white editorial illustration.
Generous negative space.
Independent art publication aesthetics.
Quiet, restrained, sophisticated visual storytelling.
Natural handwritten typography.
A balanced relationship between documentary realism and expressive hand-drawn artwork.

The overall result should resemble a carefully designed, collectible editorial art print.

6. FINAL OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS

ASPECT RATIO:
2:3 vertical.

RESOLUTION:
High-resolution, sharp, print-quality output.

COMPOSITION:

Exactly 50% original reference photography on top.

Exactly 50% editorial illustration on the bottom.

One perfectly straight horizontal dividing line.

One complete, standalone poster.

RESTRICTIONS:

No collages.
No multi-poster layouts.
No combined images.
No unnecessary decorative elements.
No modifications to the original subject's identity or appearance.
No excessive illustration details.
No changes to the original photograph's natural color relationships.

FINAL GOAL:

Create a sophisticated, visually balanced editorial art poster that faithfully preserves the uploaded reference photograph while transforming its primary subject into an expressive, minimalist black-ink illustration.

A black inner top is faintly visible beneath the neckline. She wears black thong sandals with thin straps embellished with sparkling rhinestones. Beside her hangs a small black rectangular handbag decorated with a dense pattern of silver rhinestones, featuring a slim handle and a structured silhouette.

## (Scene / Background)

A luxurious contemporary interior featuring mirrored walls, reflective glass panels, and a sophisticated boutique or high-end fashion showroom atmosphere. The woman sits on a low, elongated black upholstered bench composed of cylindrical padded sections, supported by a polished chrome and metallic frame. The floor is covered in vivid red-orange carpet, creating a dramatic contrast with the black outfit and furniture. Multiple mirrors reflect the woman, seating, handbag, and surrounding interior, producing layered reflections and visual depth. The background contains geometric glass partitions, dark metal framework, scattered warm architectural lights, and subtle reflections of other people and showroom activity. Keep the environment realistic, detailed, and consistent with a luxury fashion editorial setting.

## (Lighting / Atmosphere)

A combination of warm ambient interior lighting and intense cool-white photographic lights. Bright reflected highlights appear across the mirrored walls, metallic bench supports, and rhinestone accessories. Soft frontal illumination evenly lights the woman's face and legs, preserving natural skin texture while creating a polished editorial appearance. Warm red-orange floor reflections contrast with cool blue-white highlights in the background. Maintain realistic shadows beneath the bench and legs, controlled specular highlights, balanced exposure, and a glamorous, sophisticated nightlife atmosphere.

Vertical full-body fashion portrait. Position the woman near the center of the frame, seated on the black bench with her torso upright and legs crossed diagonally toward the lower foreground. Use a slightly elevated or eye-level frontal camera angle, with natural perspective and moderate wide-angle depth. The mirrored walls create symmetrical visual repetition and secondary reflections on both sides of the subject. Keep the woman as the primary focal point, with her face, tailored black outfit, crossed legs, and sparkling sandals sharply defined. Preserve sufficient foreground space to show the red carpet and the complete footwear without cropping.

Photorealistic luxury fashion editorial photography, contemporary Asian fashion magazine aesthetic, refined eveningwear styling, high-end designer campaign, sophisticated urban glamour, realistic human anatomy, natural facial proportions, detailed tailoring, lifelike skin texture, accurate fabric folds, polished metal reflections, and crisp rhinestone details. Ultra-high resolution, photorealistic, highly detailed, professional fashion photography, sharp facial focus, realistic hair strands, fine fabric texture, accurate hands and fingers, anatomically correct crossed legs, detailed sandals and handbag embellishments, physically plausible reflections, balanced dynamic range, clean subject separation, realistic depth of field, natural perspective, controlled highlights, rich blacks, vivid yet balanced colors, and minimal image noise.
